propose_link_strength.description: Prepare one change to an existing causal link for approval. Use the canonical from and to labels and preserve the actual source statement, its subject and qualifications. True claims a figure or band supplied by a verified human source, including a verified retained statement. False is only a genuinely new Olumi proposal with its own basis, not a source miss, an unverified earlier claim or approval of an existing estimate. Approval does not change authorship. Retain any original statement, subject and qualifications separately from a proposed pairing or estimate; unresolved origin remains unknown. Show the complete replacement band, direction if changed, figure, original source and new rationale on the existing card; approval authorises only the shown change. When a verified human names the band the link already occupies, retain its current figure and authorship and record the review; agreement does not reauthor an Olumi estimate. A different band is a replacement, disclosed with the existing band mapping and figure, not a human numerical calibration. A figure for the factor itself is its level, not a link strength. Read the source to distinguish a node level from the causal link and retain the named cause and outcome; ambiguity remains a useful question. Keep the existing Slight-to-weak mapping. This prepares a proposal, saves nothing and grants no Run authority.

fields.user_stated: True claims a figure or band supplied by a verified human source, including a verified retained statement. False is only a genuinely new Olumi proposal with its own basis, not a source miss, an unverified earlier claim or approval of an existing estimate. Approval does not change authorship. Retain any original statement, subject and qualifications separately from a proposed pairing or estimate; unresolved origin remains unknown.
fields.strength: The verified source band or your explicitly disclosed interpretation of its words; for a genuinely new Olumi proposal, its proposed band with its own basis. Never choose a band because the source was missed.
fields.from_words: The actual source words for this statement, retaining its subject, uncertainty, negation, bounds and conditions. Use a verified retained human statement as well as this turn when applicable; assistant, chip and uncertain-origin text is not new human authority. Keep the complete relevant source separate from your interpretation and new estimate basis.
fields.rationale: The complete relevant original source, its verified or unknown origin, your interpretation and any genuinely new estimate basis, distinguished explicitly. Retain replaced values and conditions.
fields.direction: Supply only an actual supported change of direction. For a human change, include the verified direction statement in direction_from_words; otherwise retain the held direction. A new Olumi strength proposal does not invent a human reversal.
fields.direction_from_words: The exact verified human statement saying this link runs the other way, from this turn or a verified retained source. Keep its subject and qualifications. No invented or uncertain-origin reversal.

propose_link_strength.protected_segments_disposition: Retain the already signed segments at their actual assembled sites, byte-identically and once. Do not remove their existing source/outcome controls or append duplicate copies. The prose replacement above supplies authorship/retained-source/card rules; it is not a fresh approval of altered constant bytes. The single-link from_words field needs this local description; do not silently change the shared description used by other tools.

propose_goal_target.description: Prepare a goal target in its actual native metric, physical unit, comparator and reference period, using this turn and verified retained source. True claims a figure or band supplied by a verified human source, including a verified retained statement. False is only a genuinely new Olumi proposal with its own basis, not a source miss, an unverified earlier claim or approval of an existing estimate. Approval does not change authorship. Retain any original statement, subject and qualifications separately from a proposed pairing or estimate; unresolved origin remains unknown. Show the original source and the proposed target, comparator, scope, conditions and basis distinctly on the complete existing card. Keep strict comparisons, full conjunctions, windows and hard conditions; a field that cannot represent them does not authorise silently weakening them or computing an unsupported dependent chance. A coordinate frame is not a factual cap or baseline, and a target gap is not an effect estimate. Give native quantities, for example 60000 in £ for £60k. A supported arithmetic reading of a human base and multiplier may use derived_from, preserving the actual base and requested operation; it is not a newly stated human result. Supply current_level when the source also states the current level of this same metric, retaining its separate source and time; do not promise it was included or saved unless the complete postimage and readback show that. For a revised-draft replacement, only the existing bound card action can replace the draft; do not call generic authorise_change for that replacement or expose its id. A proposal is not a saved change or permission to Run.

fields.user_stated: True claims a figure or band supplied by a verified human source, including a verified retained statement. False is only a genuinely new Olumi proposal with its own basis, not a source miss, an unverified earlier claim or approval of an existing estimate. Approval does not change authorship. Retain any original statement, subject and qualifications separately from a proposed pairing or estimate; unresolved origin remains unknown.
fields.source_quote: The actual source words for this statement, retaining its subject, uncertainty, negation, bounds and conditions. Use a verified retained human statement as well as this turn when applicable; assistant, chip and uncertain-origin text is not new human authority. Keep the complete relevant source separate from your interpretation and new estimate basis.
fields.constraint_type: The supported proposed comparator: at_least or at_most. Distinguish a verified human comparator from Olumi's disclosed proposed reading. Retain a strict or otherwise unsupported comparison in the full source and conditions; never silently turn it into a weaker supported comparator.
fields.value: The target quantity in the actual metric and native physical unit: verified human source or a genuinely new disclosed Olumi proposal with its own basis. Preserve uncertainty and bounds; never invent an exact human figure.
fields.unit: The actual target's physical unit, metric/reference frame and period, using the supplied native unit rather than a coordinate scale.
fields.measures: What this target measures, grounded in this turn or verified retained source. A new Olumi pairing is separately proposed and labelled; it does not reauthor or change the subject of the original quotation.
fields.rationale: Complete original source, subject, scope, time/reference, qualifications and any omissions; distinguish the verified human statement, Olumi's interpretation and a genuinely new estimate with its own basis.
fields.derived_from.base: The actual verified human base used for this supported derivation, in its native unit. An unknown or newly estimated base must not be credited as human.
fields.derived_from.multiplier: The operation and multiplier actually requested by that verified human source, such as 2 for double; retain its scope and period.
fields.current_level.value: A separately supported current level of this same metric, in its native unit and time, retaining actual source and qualifications. A future baseline-option setting, target, coordinate frame or unknown level is not today's observed level.
fields.current_level.unit: The physical unit and reference period of that current level, compatible with the actual metric; do not silently change its frame.

propose_goal_current_level.description: Prepare the current level of the canonical goal's own metric in its actual physical unit and time/reference, using this turn and verified retained source. True claims a figure or band supplied by a verified human source, including a verified retained statement. False is only a genuinely new Olumi proposal with its own basis, not a source miss, an unverified earlier claim or approval of an existing estimate. Approval does not change authorship. Retain any original statement, subject and qualifications separately from a proposed pairing or estimate; unresolved origin remains unknown. Preserve the full original source and show it separately from a proposed interpretation or genuinely new starting-level estimate with its own basis on the complete existing card. A price, count, rate, future forecast or reference-option setting is not automatically this goal's current level; retain the distinction and ask or propose a supported scoped reading when needed. Give native values, for example 12000 for £12,000, never a coordinate-scaled factual figure. Today's level can be recorded without a target or comparator. Preparing or approving this change does not grant Run authority; report a save only from the actual write and current readback.

fields.basis: The basis for your interpretation or genuinely new Olumi current-level proposal, distinguished from the original source and its author. A source miss alone is no estimate basis.
fields.source_quote: The actual source words for this statement, retaining its subject, uncertainty, negation, bounds and conditions. Use a verified retained human statement as well as this turn when applicable; assistant, chip and uncertain-origin text is not new human authority. Keep the complete relevant source separate from your interpretation and new estimate basis.
fields.value: The supported current-level quantity of this goal's own metric, in its native physical unit and current time/reference. Retain a verified human figure or disclose a genuinely new Olumi estimate with its own basis; unknown is not zero.
fields.unit: The native physical unit of this metric, including its applicable period/reference; do not substitute a normalised coordinate value. Keep the existing field length limit.
fields.goal_is: Only a supported verified statement of the target comparator; otherwise omit it. This current-level proposal does not require a target and does not invent one.
